description.value: A Circle K convenience store and petrol station on Cook Street in Victoria, open around the clock every day of the week. The store offers packaged snacks and drinks alongside hot food options including a roller grill and freshly brewed coffee. Its central Victoria location and 24-hour availability make it a practical resupply stop for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a Circle K convenience store and petrol station at 1515 Cook Street, Victoria, BC V8T 5E5, open 24 hours. Services listed on the store page include Fresh Food Fast, Coffee, and Roller Grill, confirming basic groceries and hot food. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or water refill anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: The website page header reads 'Petrol station at 1515 COOK STREET, VICTORIA, United States' — country is incorrectly stated as United States in the header, though the store details correctly show 'V8T 5E5, CA' (Canada). Likely a website templating error.
OSM record has no address or phone fields populated; both were sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Store is a legitimate 24-hour convenience stop with food and snacks useful to cyclists, but required criteria (bike parking, water bottle refill) cannot be confirmed from available evidence and would need on-the-ground verification before inclusion.
